notes.title: Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Three Alpha One Nine is now available![/h1]

[b]Get ready for a unique challenge as you play as 3A19, a specialized robot designed by IMI Energy Solutions to collect Energy Cells located throughout time and space.[/b]

On your adventure you will encounter various enemies and tricky environments that will test your abilities to the limits.

Your employer, IMI, will keep you updated on your progress, rank your time and damage limitation skills, as well as reward you for your continued excellence.

Be on the lookout for your fallen comrades and their SSD Drives they have left behind. Each one will contain a new insight into IMI's working conditions.

Every second counts, every jump needs attention, and every cell needs to be collected for the betterment of all humankind.

[b]Are you up for the test?[/b]

notes.title: Update: 1.2.5 - Pre-Release
notes.content:
[h1]Update V.1.2.5[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Re-designed the Rating System to a more streamlined Experience System
[*] Updated UI game wide for ease of use and access to information (including experience progress bar)
[*] Screen effects tweaked (Player Hit and Player Land)
[*] Collision fixes on most levels to stop unintended physics fluctuations
[*] New message indicator for new messages within the messaging system
[*] Fixed "Fastest Time" not displaying correctly if Time Achieved was more than the "Acceptable Time" threshold.
[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] General tweaks to all levels for increased frame rate
[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*] Customizable graphics options added for user
[*] Level intros updated for all levels
[/list]
